yurt.artkyUzuk.description: A felt sheet that covers the upper, rear part of the dome over the uuks.
yurt.artkyUzuk.meaning: The edges of the uzuks are trimmed with woollen cord — both a decoration and protection against wear.
yurt.artkyUzuk.name: Arkty uzuk
yurt.artkyUzuk.purpose: Protects the vault from rain, snow and wind and keeps the warmth inside.
yurt.astynkyUzuk.description: The lower felt sheet of the dome, laid over the uuks from the kerege up to the upper uzuk.
yurt.astynkyUzuk.meaning: Over the uzuk the yurt is criss-crossed with ropes — their pattern is clearly visible from outside.
yurt.astynkyUzuk.name: Astynky uzuk
yurt.astynkyUzuk.purpose: Covers the lower part of the vault and overlaps the tuurduk, leaving no gaps.
yurt.chamgarak.description: Curved wooden arches that cross inside the tündük ring and form its convex dome.
yurt.chamgarak.meaning: The crossed arches of the chamgarak are depicted inside the sun on the state flag of Kyrgyzstan.
yurt.chamgarak.name: Chamgarak
yurt.chamgarak.purpose: They make the tündük rigid and keep the ring from warping under the weight of the uuks and felt.
yurt.chiy.description: A mat of steppe chiy grass stems. Each stem is wrapped in coloured wool, and together they form an ornament.
yurt.chiy.meaning: Ornamented chiy (oroo chiy) is one of the most labour-intensive women’s crafts, and the whole family is proud of it.
yurt.chiy.name: Chiy
yurt.chiy.purpose: Placed between the kerege and the felt: protects from wind and dust and lets air through in the heat.
yurt.eshik.description: The entrance to the yurt: a wooden door frame (bosogo) and a felt flap that is rolled up and tied above during the day.
yurt.eshik.meaning: The threshold is the border of the home world: no one steps or sits on it. The entrance traditionally faces east, towards the sunrise.
yurt.eshik.name: Eshik
yurt.eshik.purpose: Closes the doorway in the ring of the kerege and protects from cold and wind.
yurt.jabykBash.description: A band of felt or fabric with embroidered ornament and tassels that runs in a circle along the uuks inside the yurt.
yurt.jabykBash.meaning: The patterns of the jabyk bash express wishes of plenty and well-being for the family living under this dome.
yurt.jabykBash.name: Jabyk bash
yurt.jabykBash.purpose: It decorates the vault from inside and additionally binds the uuks together.
yurt.kerege.description: A collapsible lattice wall. It consists of separate sections — kanats — tied to one another with straps.
yurt.kerege.meaning: The size of a yurt is measured by the number of kanats. The most common is alty kanat, a yurt of six sections.
yurt.kerege.name: Kerege
yurt.kerege.purpose: The load-bearing round base of the yurt; folded, it is easy to carry on a horse or a camel.
yurt.keregeChalgych.description: A wide woven band that encircles the kerege at the very top, where the uuks are attached to the walls.
yurt.keregeChalgych.meaning: The band is woven with an ornament, so inside the yurt it is both a fastening and a decoration.
yurt.keregeChalgych.name: Kerege chalgych
yurt.keregeChalgych.purpose: It pulls the walls together and takes the thrust of the uuks, keeping the kerege from spreading.
yurt.kyrchoo.description: Braided woollen ropes that encircle the yurt from outside along the walls and dome.
yurt.kyrchoo.meaning: Thanks to the ropes and the flexible frame, the yurt withstands strong winds and even earthquakes.
yurt.kyrchoo.name: Kyrchoo
yurt.kyrchoo.purpose: They press the felt to the frame so the wind does not tear the cover off.
yurt.size.title: Alty kanat — a yurt with six kerege sections
yurt.tizgich.description: A narrow band that runs in a circle through all the uuks at about the middle of the dome.
yurt.tizgich.meaning: A small part without which the dome loses its shape: each pole holds together with all the others.
yurt.tizgich.name: Tizgich
yurt.tizgich.purpose: It pulls the uuks together and keeps an even spacing between them so the poles do not spread.
yurt.tunduk.description: A round wooden ring at the top of the dome. The upper ends of all the uuks are inserted into its openings.
yurt.tunduk.meaning: A symbol of the hearth, the family line and continuity: the tündük is passed down as an heirloom. A sunbeam passing through the tündük and moving along the walls served nomads as a clock — it told the time of day.
yurt.tunduk.name: Tündük
yurt.tunduk.purpose: Closes and holds the dome, serving as a skylight and a smoke hole for the hearth.
yurt.tundukJabuu.description: A separate square piece of felt that covers the tündük from above. Ropes are tied to its corners.
yurt.tundukJabuu.meaning: A closed tündük jabuu in the morning means the household is still asleep; an open one means the day has begun.
yurt.tundukJabuu.name: Tündük jabuu
yurt.tundukJabuu.purpose: From inside, a rope opens or closes the tündük: letting light in, letting smoke out, keeping warmth at night and in bad weather.
yurt.tuurduk.description: Long felt sheets wrapped around the kerege from outside, over the chiy.
yurt.tuurduk.meaning: Felt for the tuurduk is made by the whole family together with neighbours — shared work and a shared celebration.
yurt.tuurduk.name: Tuurduk
yurt.tuurduk.purpose: They insulate the walls and protect them from wind. In summer the lower edge is raised to air the yurt.
yurt.uuk.description: The long curved poles of the dome. Their upper ends go into the tündük, the lower ones are tied to the tops of the kerege.
yurt.uuk.meaning: The uuks radiate from the tündük like rays from the sun — so from inside, the vault of the yurt reads as an image of the sky.
yurt.uuk.name: Uuk
yurt.uuk.purpose: They form the roof frame and transfer the weight of the dome and felt cover to the walls.
yurt.uuktunMatoosu.description: Loops and straps that tie the lower ends of the uuks to the forks at the tops of the kerege.
yurt.uuktunMatoosu.meaning: A yurt is assembled without a single nail — everything rests on the precise fit of the wood and strong bindings.
yurt.uuktunMatoosu.name: Uuktun matoosu
yurt.uuktunMatoosu.purpose: They join the dome and the walls into a single structure that is easy to take apart and put together.
